claims.statement: FDC alarm fired on DEP01-B for LOT-1239 with heater reading 413.381 above 403.0
DEP01-B heater averaged 400.587 then jumped to last value 413.381 at 72.0
DEP01-B thickness before the jump averaged 502.024 with last value 503.17
LOT-1239 wafer measured 515.01 on MET01 and is out of spec and out of control
Heater recent mean is 406.42 vs baseline 400.0 with z_score 21.0 while other z_scores are 1.1 and 0.4 and 1.0
DEP step differs with p value 0.0019 and DEP01-B mean 502.71 while CLEAN p is 0.8368 and MET p is 0.7355

disposition.summary: Heater on DEP01-B suddenly ran hotter at LOT-1239 and that wafer came out thick out-of-spec at 515.01 vs 502 before. This is a real heater shift, not a sensor misread. Hold the lot and the chamber.

truth.explanation: The heater on DEP01-B really is running hot; films since then are thick.

public: Plummer, Deal, Griffin, course notes for Silicon VLSI Technology, ch. 9 (thin film deposition)
In the reaction-limited regime CVD deposition rate follows an Arrhenius law and is very temperature sensitive.
sources.practitioner: A real temperature change shows up in the film on wafers processed after it; a sensor fault does not.
